Step 3. The torsion-free functional \(\Phi_{01319983}\) on the affine variety satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01319983}\| \leq C_01319983\) by the torsion-free embedding theorem.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Fourier approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
